title: The Cyclic Interaction of the Compalphas
deck:
Cyclic Interaction is the oscillatory mechanism through which
            Alpha-Axis states propagate across connected Compalphas without
            transporting particles or substance.

concise.body:
Prologue

This chapter seeks to clarify that the Cyclic Interaction, the second fundamentally basic type of geometric interaction, is directly responsible for what physicists term "electromagnetic interaction." It is the oscillatory and vibratory interaction that occurs within the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, formed by the continuous and infinite connection of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons.

Cyclic Interaction: Remote oscillatory and vibratory interaction

Rotating Interaction is responsible for the logical formation of the Geometric Continuum structure; it determines the order of the Apparent Rotational Synchronism of the Interaction Circles that constitute the Compalphas, which, in turn, integrate all types of Merons.

Cyclic Interaction, which we will examine in this chapter, is responsible for the Apparent Oscillations/Vibrations of the Geometric Hypercontinuum structure; it determines how the Compalphas forming the Merons can oscillate and vibrate in an apparent mode.

Cyclic Interaction and Rotating Interaction, as described by TUIDG, are the two fundamental geometric mechanisms that account for all natural physical processes occurring in the universe.

Thus, if one Compalpha has its oscillation-vibration amplitude and frequency "states," as well as the position and orientation of its Alpha Axis, directed "upward" (or toward any of the twelve spatial orientations), the Alpha Axis of another immediately closer Compalpha (relative proximity) will have its amplitude, frequency, position, and orientation states directed "downward." This forms a type of "bound state" of interaction at a distance—merely a geometric "bond" promoted by a Common Interaction Circle specific to the two Compalphas. Determining the maximum possible oscillatory amplitude at specific energy levels reached in different processes is essential; such values can only be found through simulations in specialized software, combined with the study of tests on certain types of materials under thermal expansion, such as diamond pieces based on the Dodecacube Meron at 100% purity (carbon-12).

In the adjacent animation, we can understand the principle of functionality of Cyclic Interaction, an interaction quantified and described by trigonometry.

If the supposed "fundamental particles" of matter described by physicists were truly formed by "energy" concentrated at points in space, how would they be capable of generating continuous "force fields" capable of acting upon other "particles" if the space between them, in itself, represented the Absolute Empty Space?

By the logic of TUIDG, it is not enough to say that there is some type of "ghostly interaction at a distance," of "quantum entanglement," of a connection at a distance, or an exchange of "information" between particles separated by the void across any distance.

For such "fundamental particles" of physics, if the "force field" were produced by the action of increasingly smaller "particles," it would also encounter the same degree of logical impossibility.

For classical physics, it was all a matter of real forces that could be measured with some precision, but what does quantum physics say about the electric field?

The adjacent animation graphically represents what quantum physics describes as the Strong Interaction.

But where is the force field that is capable of attracting or repelling masses?

The truth is that all the explanations given by physicists do not satisfactorily answer any open question, and what they really do with their inconsistent models is merely rescale the interactive structure of the supposed "fundamental particles" to smaller and smaller "structural dimensions", nothing more than that.

Cyclic Interaction, the true oscillatory and vibratory "force field"

According to TUIDG's propositions, the means by which absolutely all structures in the universe communicate remotely is not through the ghostly structure of a luminiferous ether or through any type of corpuscular structure that physicists mistakenly call "field", as these two ideas are truly absurd.

These geometric mechanisms, in fact, are nothing more than absolutely static interactive mechanisms, which are realized apparently in the structure of Geometric Hypercontinuums, since, as we have seen, there is no real movement, but only an infinity of relationships between distinct geometric snapshots, so that the supposed 4 fundamental forces, from the faintest electromagnetic radiation, to the highest level of radiation, according to TUIDG, are nothing more than the manifestation of these two geometric mechanisms.

In the animations on the side, some characteristics of the Cyclic Interaction between what would be 5 Compalphas are shown.

The Apparent Motion of Cyclic Interaction

Does energy exist?

According to TUIDG, any and all forms of "energy", in reality, are nothing more than an Apparent Motion, carried out by the geometric structures that constitute the universe.

Thus, Cyclic Interaction is the oscillation-vibration movement of the Compalphas axes, resulting in the increase and decrease in the radii of the Interaction Circles. In the Cyclic Interaction process, shown in Presentation 5.4, we can have a vague idea about how this Apparent Motion is processed in the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum.

We can see a progressive simplification of the crystalline structure of any material (represented on a plane), with just a few Compalphas, a small portion of space expanded to the level of organization of just a few Alpha Sextets. Firstly, in this small fragment of matter, the aspect of the Geometric Continuum is shown in a fundamental state of structuring, in this state, all the Compalphas Interaction Circles have the same dimension, all the axes are at 60º, in relation to each other, and all the planes are at 120 degrees, in relation to each other as well.

Secondly, the relative positions of all elements are modified depending on the displacement of the axes by 2 degrees, that is, the axes “rotate” around the points by 2 degrees of arc, some at - 2 degrees, others at + 2 degrees. The planes “rotate” together with the axes at -2 degrees and +2 degrees and the circles undergo changes in their dimensions due to the Cyclic Interaction between them.

The representation of the Compalphas axes in the Geometric Hypercontinuum, made in Presentation 5.4, shows only one of the three structuring planes of the circles that constitute it, that is, it is only the representation of the bidirectional shape (2D). In fact, the geometric elements of the Geometric Continuum and the Hypercontinuum are structured in space in a tridirectional (3D) manner.

When the relative angular states of the Alpha Axes oscillate through individual excursions of +60° and −60°, producing a 120° peak-to-peak amplitude, six of the Interaction Circles (they are just the common circles of interaction between the Compalphas) ​​become smaller and another six become infinitely larger. In the same way, the 12 Alpha Points (of the cuboctahedral structure) also alternate their spatial positions in a number of six, that is, six points approach each other and six points move away to infinity. In presentation 5.5 below, some aspects of the Cyclic Interaction happening in the structure of a single Metalpha Meron (hydrogen atom) are being shown, however, the way it happens in its structure, it happens in the structure of all Merons.

Cyclic Interaction and Classical Electromagnetism

According to TUIDG, the physical phenomenon traditionally known as electromagnetism is in no way a product of the variation in the state of supposed electric and magnetic fields that propagate through space, sometimes as a wave, sometimes as a particle, as such a description is nothing more than a kind of transport of matter in the form of supposed mediating particles (photons) of the field in question.

It has Oscillatory Amplitude, however, for the Alpha Axes and not for the "width" of the band occupied by a supposed wave-particle.

It has an oscillatory frequency, however, for the angular variation of these Alpha Axes and not for the number of times that a supposed wave-particle "rises and falls" along the band.

It has an apparent propagation speed, however, for the disturbances produced by the angular variations of the Compalphas axes along the Geometric Hypercontinuum, and not for the displacement of a supposed wave-particle throughout space. This speed is ~300,000 km/s (speed of light), in case the medium is the Alpha Geometric Hypercontinuum (vacuum in the Merons dimension), or the speed of high light (vacuum in the star dimension), in the case of the medium being the Iota Geometric Hypercontinuum, but which has yet to be calculated.

The set of oscillatory amplitude and frequency states, in TUIDG, can be called an oscillatory or vibrational state (energetic state), as the Geometric Hypercontinuum, in fact, apparently vibrates with greater or lesser amplitude and frequency.

The amount of light emitted or absorbed by a body in a unit of time, on the other hand, is due to a greater or lesser amount of Merons or molecules that are mobilized in the structure of these bodies, that is, they depend on the “mass” of the emitter.

Two distinct systems may be vibrating (oscillation of the Compalphas axes) with the same amplitude, but with different frequencies (of oscillation) or they may have the same frequency and different amplitudes.

Prologue

This chapter seeks to clarify that the Cyclic Interaction, the second fundamentally basic type of geometric interaction, is directly responsible for what physicists term "electromagnetic interaction." It is the oscillatory and vibratory interaction that occurs within the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, formed by the continuous and infinite connection of the Compalphas that constitute the Merons. It is responsible for what we understand to be heat, visible light, ultraviolet rays, X-rays, gamma rays, and the entire spectrum of "electromagnetic radiations" in conventional physics. However, it also exists only in an apparent mode, as an Apparent Oscillation/Vibration, as a product of an Apparent Motion provided by the structure of the Geometric Hypercontinuum, given that motion does not fundamentally exist.

Cyclic Interaction: Remote oscillatory and vibratory interaction

Rotating Interaction is responsible for the logical formation of the Geometric Continuum structure; it determines the order of the Apparent Rotational Synchronism of the Interaction Circles that constitute the Compalphas, which, in turn, integrate all types of Merons. It is responsible for the formation and maintenance of the logical integrity of the structure of "Apparent Matter." In conventional physical terms, it is the equivalent of the Strong Force (when in the process of Meronic formation) and the Weak Force (when in the process of rupturing the Apparent Rotational Synchronism of the Interaction Circles of the Compalphas that constitute all types of Merons in the universe).

Cyclic Interaction, which we will examine in this chapter, is responsible for the Apparent Oscillations/Vibrations of the Geometric Hypercontinuum structure; it determines how the Compalphas forming the Merons can oscillate and vibrate in an apparent mode. It is responsible for the transmission process of the Apparent Motion of oscillation/vibration of the Compalphas' axes from one point to others within the Absolute Empty Space. This interaction is responsible for all electrical processes and acts indirectly in magnetic and gravitational processes, in the formation of different types of Merons and molecules, and participates in all physico-chemical processes derived from these.

Cyclic Interaction and Rotating Interaction, as described by TUIDG, are the two fundamental geometric mechanisms that account for all natural physical processes occurring in the universe. Cyclic Interaction acts as a fundamentally oscillatory/vibratory geometric mechanism of Apparent Matter, without the transport of any quantity of exotic substance or energy from point A to point B in space—that is, without the transport of corpuscular or wave-like "energy" ("photons") described by traditional physics. In conventional physical terms, the most basic interaction between two "fundamental particles" would occur through the "exchange" of supposed gluons between two supposed quarks (in the structure of what is called a proton) or by supposed photons between one of these quarks and a supposed electron (in the structure called a hydrogen atom). In TUIDG, however, the most basic interaction occurs via an Interaction Circle between two Alpha Points, or rather, between two Compalphas, since it is through the circular geometric elements forming the Compalphas—called Interaction Circles—that Rotating Interaction and Cyclic Interaction take place.

Thus, if one Compalpha has its oscillation-vibration amplitude and frequency "states," as well as the position and orientation of its Alpha Axis, directed "upward" (or toward any of the twelve spatial orientations), the Alpha Axis of another immediately closer Compalpha (relative proximity) will have its amplitude, frequency, position, and orientation states directed "downward." This forms a type of "bound state" of interaction at a distance—merely a geometric "bond" promoted by a Common Interaction Circle specific to the two Compalphas. Nevertheless, as with almost all concepts present in TUIDG, appropriate mathematical developments are still lacking, such as those referring to the oscillation angles of the Compalphas' axes for each type of "electromagnetic radiation" emitted by different types of Merons. Determining the maximum possible oscillatory amplitude at specific energy levels reached in different processes is essential; such values can only be found through simulations in specialized software, combined with the study of tests on certain types of materials under thermal expansion, such as diamond pieces based on the Dodecacube Meron at 100% purity (carbon-12).

Presentation — The principle of functionality of Cyclic Interaction

In the adjacent animation, we can understand the principle of functionality of Cyclic Interaction, an interaction quantified and described by trigonometry. We must note that this animation displays only the Alpha Points, the Alpha Axes (red arrows), and the Alpha Planes (represented by green lines on the image plane) of two Compalphas in the process of Rotating Interaction and Cyclic Interaction.

According to the propositions of TUIDG, the fact that physicists accept the existence of matter (and/or energy), a non-absolute space, and time as real entities is what leads conventional science to develop inconsistent theoretical models regarding the structure of these "elements." There exist different and self-conflicting models of structures and functionalities that are unsustainable regarding the same natural physical phenomenon—models based on uncertainties and conceptual dualities that lead to insoluble paradoxes.

If the supposed "fundamental particles" of matter described by physicists were truly formed by "energy" concentrated at points in space, how would they be capable of generating continuous "force fields" capable of acting upon other "particles" if the space between them, in itself, represented the Absolute Empty Space? This question leads us to think that any idea of a "force field" could only be conceived as being due to the action of even smaller "particles" produced by the former. This is, in fact, what modern physicists think, for, from a logical standpoint, the absolute void that would necessarily exist between the supposed "particles" could not influence nor be influenced by the supposed "particles" of any dimension that might exist, since "nothingness" itself does not interact with anything.

By the logic of TUIDG, it is not enough to say that there is some type of "ghostly interaction at a distance," of "quantum entanglement," of a connection at a distance, or an exchange of "information" between particles separated by the void across any distance. It is not enough to say there is a type of "bizarre entanglement" where there is no direct contact between the "particles" separated by the void. To say that pairs of particles "are born knowing" that they possess characteristics of synchronism at a distance is simply absurd. If particles really existed, it would be more logical to accept that, despite having the same physical properties—such as mass, charge, spin, etc.—they would be completely independent and oblivious to one another until the exact moment they entered into "physical contact" through some force external to those same "particles." In a certain way, the geometric interactions of TUIDG assume a type of "entanglement at a distance," but with logical and specific forms and modes of action, as is the case with the Rotating Interaction and Cyclic Interaction.

For such "fundamental particles" of physics, if the "force field" were produced by the action of increasingly smaller "particles," it would also encounter the same degree of logical impossibility. Regardless of the dimensions of the supposed "mediator particles," the same "nothingness" would obviously be present in the space between them, thus equating to the impossible case of the action of "nothing" upon anything, only in increasingly smaller dimensions. This process of indefinite search for the fundamental mediator "particle" is called, in TUIDG, the Axiomatic Principle of Necessarily Indefinite Fragmentation. In other words, it is logically impossible for two "masses" separated by any distance—and therefore by an absolutely empty space—to exert attractive or repulsive influences while still separated at the moment of the supposed interaction. This is characterized as a restriction on the capacity for logical interactivity between any eventual corpuscles of any dimension that might exist. This is the problem expressed by the Axiomatic Principle of Logical-Constructive Interactive Incapacity.

For classical physics, it was all a matter of real forces that could be measured with some precision, but what does quantum physics say about the electric field? For quantum chromodynamics, quantum electrodynamics, and quantum gravitation, the concept of field is somewhat different. In these, a field is the region of space with the highest probability of the existence of a mediator particle—such as gluons, responsible for the strong force; W and Z bosons, responsible for the electroweak force; or photons, responsible for the electromagnetic force—that is capable of influencing a "mass" corresponding to its specific class of mediation. Thus, the concept of "force field" must be more comprehensive than that of "electric force," as the latter is merely one of the variants of the notion of "force field."

The adjacent animation graphically represents what quantum physics describes as the Strong Interaction. Once again, however, it presents "point particles" separated by empty spaces.

But where is the force field that is capable of attracting or repelling masses? What is it actually made of?

The truth is that all the explanations given by physicists do not satisfactorily answer any open question, and what they really do with their inconsistent models is merely rescale the interactive structure of the supposed "fundamental particles" to smaller and smaller "structural dimensions", nothing more than that.

To accept that such "balls of matter" interact through "little balls of energy" as though this constituted an "ideal field" is equivalent to accepting that the dynamic behavior of billiard balls is also produced by the action of fields, and not by the direct action of the masses, in the form of mutual contacts (shocks), which are unilateral and time-dependent. Accepting that there is a "force field" at the same time that we are not able to demonstrate its true structure, we can conclude that a contradiction arises in relation to the concept of "force field", since these fields would exist without having any structure in space. Supposing that there was a type of particle, then its interaction field, its mode of interaction at a distance with other similar particles, would be something similar to what we can see in animation 5.2 above, which is a simplified representation, in bidirectional mode (2D).

Cyclic Interaction, the true oscillatory and vibratory "force field"

According to TUIDG's propositions, the means by which absolutely all structures in the universe communicate remotely is not through the ghostly structure of a luminiferous ether or through any type of corpuscular structure that physicists mistakenly call "field", as these two ideas are truly absurd. The so-called "luminiferous ether", postulated by 19th century scientists, which would permeate all bodies and which was like a ghostly gas, made up of a transparent substance, undetectable by chemical or physical means, elastic and which would not cause friction to bodies traveling through it, would be perfect, however, contradictory in view of the logic that governs the interactions between the supposed "particles" of the current quantum context.

But it would be exactly these incredible properties that light and all radiation, including the attraction of gravity, would need to be conducted from one point to another in space, however, it would be an unacceptable structure from a logical and rational point of view, at least when the existence of real corpuscular substantiality in the universe is accepted. So, according to TUIDG, everything that gives us the idea of ​​a "force field" acting at a distance, absolutely all fields described by physics, are in fact manifestations of two absolutely geometric mechanisms. One is the Rotating Interaction mechanism which, in conventional physical terms, is equivalent to the "color field", the "electric field", the "magnetic field" and the "gravitational field". While the second is the Cyclic Interaction mechanism, which is equivalent to the "variant fields" of physics, as is the case with the processes of electricity and electromagnetic radiation as a whole.

These geometric mechanisms, in fact, are nothing more than absolutely static interactive mechanisms, which are realized apparently in the structure of Geometric Hypercontinuums, since, as we have seen, there is no real movement, but only an infinity of relationships between distinct geometric snapshots, so that the supposed 4 fundamental forces, from the faintest electromagnetic radiation, to the highest level of radiation, according to TUIDG, are nothing more than the manifestation of these two geometric mechanisms.

According to TUIDG, the geometric mechanism of Cyclic Interaction does indeed act as a true "field of interaction at a distance", very much in the style of what should really be an ideal field, the classic field of lines of force, because between any two (or more) points in space there are always lines of the geometry of Apparent Matter acting on each element. And such fields are simply fields of geometric interaction, not a force field of quantum physics, which, in fact, is nothing more than a corpuscular system. Does energy exist? Is it the product of the "conversion" of matter? Is it the ability to perform work? Is it the change in the state of one system as a function of another? Is there a fundamental difference between one type of energy and another? Heat is something fundamentally different from electricity or visible light, are they three distinct mechanisms? These questions, supposedly already resolved, remain far from any definitive conclusion. Matter does not "convert" into energy, nor is the opposite true.

According to TUIDG, any and all forms of "energy", in reality, are nothing more than an Apparent Motion, carried out by the geometric structures that constitute the universe. Its most common form is the Apparent Motion of oscillation-vibration of the Compalphas axes, in this case, the Cyclic Interaction, which we understand as an "electromagnetic wave". Since its smallest quantity is impossible, there is no smaller quantity of oscillation-vibration, there is no discrete quantum of anything, since the difference is only in the degree of oscillation of the axes, in the angle at which the axes of the Compalphas oscillate.

Thus, Cyclic Interaction is the oscillation-vibration movement of the Compalphas axes, resulting in the increase and decrease in the radii of the Interaction Circles. It is only possible thanks to the infinite states of distinct static configurations that our base Geometric Hypercontinuum can allow. These static configurations are different "photos", "drawings" or snapshots of bodies within the Apparent Reality, that is, they are infinite superimpositions of the variations in the spatial positions of the points, axes, planes and the diameters of the circles that constitute the Compalphas, which are the basic units, which constitute all types of Merons that, in turn, constitute the Apparent Matter of the universe. Cyclic Interaction and Classical Electromagnetism

According to TUIDG, the physical phenomenon traditionally known as electromagnetism is in no way a product of the variation in the state of supposed electric and magnetic fields that propagate through space, sometimes as a wave, sometimes as a particle, as such a description is nothing more than a kind of transport of matter in the form of supposed mediating particles (photons) of the field in question. Thus contradicting the idea that waves, as a whole, do not transport matter. Such a phenomenon, according to TUIDG, is just a purely geometric mechanism that takes place in the form of (infinite) distinct states of static configurations of the Compalphas in any Geometric Hypercontinuum, in this case the Hypercontinuum of the Alpha Dimension, with absolutely no form of transport whatsoever. The different positions of the Compalpha axes, which form this structure, generate different static geometric configurations and these, in turn, when related to each other, make it appear that there is a propagation movement in space. Cyclic Interaction differs almost completely from the functional description of conventional electromagnetic waves, however, this geometric mechanism nevertheless has the following characteristics:

It has Oscillatory Amplitude, however, for the Alpha Axes and not for the "width" of the band occupied by a supposed wave-particle. This amplitude of the axes is responsible for the power of the radiant action (in the case of traditional electromagnetic waves, which is understood as an increase in frequency) and for the electrical potential (in the case of the electrical process by DDP), that is, for the traditional increase in frequency and DDP.

It has an oscillatory frequency, however, for the angular variation of these Alpha Axes and not for the number of times that a supposed wave-particle "rises and falls" along the band. This frequency is responsible for the different work speeds, that is, for the property of luminous and electrical intermittency.

It has an apparent propagation speed, however, for the disturbances produced by the angular variations of the Compalphas axes along the Geometric Hypercontinuum, and not for the displacement of a supposed wave-particle throughout space. This speed is ~300,000 km/s (speed of light), in case the medium is the Alpha Geometric Hypercontinuum (vacuum in the Merons dimension), or the speed of high light (vacuum in the star dimension), in the case of the medium being the Iota Geometric Hypercontinuum, but which has yet to be calculated.

As examples, be the cases of the progressive change in the color of a thermal object, which goes from red to white or the increase in the electrical potential difference (DDP) between the terminals of a conductor.

The amount of light emitted or absorbed by a body in a unit of time, on the other hand, is due to a greater or lesser amount of Merons or molecules that are mobilized in the structure of these bodies, that is, they depend on the “mass” of the emitter. As an example of this, we can cite the case of monochromatic light emitted by a laser diode, its intensity can be greater as more diodes are added, without, however, changing color.

Two distinct systems may be vibrating (oscillation of the Compalphas axes) with the same amplitude, but with different frequencies (of oscillation) or they may have the same frequency and different amplitudes. The greater or lesser oscillatory amplitude of a system is provided by the greater or lesser intensity of the generating action. This generating action presents itself as a greater geometric density (in the form of pressure in the case of combustion and “nuclear fusion” processes) or as a greater geometric organization — in the form of a magnetic field (in the case of traditional electric current). According to TUIDG, the increase in the oscillatory amplitude of the Alpha Axes with invariant frequency is the physical equivalent of the increase in frequency of traditional “electromagnetic waves”. The oscillatory frequency is responsible for changes that depend on actions at a higher level than the system itself, as it is provided by many factors such as the rotation frequency of the turns or the magnetic field of an electric generator or by electronic devices such as transistors.
